_documentation: Antigravity Stop hook stdin fixture. Purpose: Stop fires when the agent loop ends a turn; on_stop runs a final on_sync, then - only when fullyIdle is true and the conversation has a Stash session row - spawns the detached transcript upload. Usage: piped to `stash hook run antigravity on_stop` by test_hook_scripts_execute.py; the leading _documentation key is not a real payload field and is ignored by the hook parser.
